steps.en: Install the skill globally into your harness
steps.zh: 把 skill 全局装进你的 harness

steps.en: Paste your draft with the command
steps.zh: 带上命令把草稿贴进去

steps.en: Loads the SKILL.md rule set and reads the full draft before touching anything
steps.zh: 加载 SKILL.md 规则集，动手前先通读全文

steps.en: Inventories your voice traits, then makes minimum effective edits against the pattern lists
steps.zh: 盘点你的声音特质，再按模式清单做最小有效修改

steps.en: Runs the eval.md pass/fail checks on its own edit and fixes failures
steps.zh: 对自己的改稿跑 eval.md 的 pass/fail 检查，修掉不合格项

steps.en: Read the returned draft plus the What changed list; keep it or push back on specific edits
steps.zh: 读返回的改后稿和 What changed 清单；收下，或对具体改动提出异议

value.en: The de-slopped draft still sounds like you, and every change is listed so you accept or reject each one instead of hand-reverting an over-edit
value.zh: 去掉机器腔的稿子听起来仍像你本人，且每处改动都列了清单——逐条接受或拒绝，不用再手动撤销过度编辑

sources: https://github.com/petergyang/no-ai-slop README — Install (npx skills add petergyang/no-ai-slop --skill no-ai-slop --global --yes) and How to use (/no-ai-slop (your writing); /no-ai-slop is this slop? (your writing))

skills/no-ai-slop/SKILL.md — Two jobs (Edit default / Detect), Workflow steps 1-6 (read full draft; identify core point and voice traits; check edited draft against eval.md; output edited draft + What changed)
skills/no-ai-slop/eval.md — pass/fail checklist run after the rewrite (editing principles, words to cut, patterns to cut, final read)
